1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

1702|745e3347.name: Bronk Guzzlegear
1702|745e3347.text: Lookin' to be an engineer, eh? Well, by Muradin, ye've come to the right place!

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

8508|15b608c8.name: Gretta Ganter
8508|15b608c8.text: Lookin' to fish? Then you'll need the proper tools.

287-complete.name: Senir Whitebeard
287-complete.text:
Ah, $N! I didn't think you'd have much trouble finding the place, my directions are excellent, you know...

Let me just finish up my report then.

<He brings out some paper and scribbles on it momentarily.>

There! Well, haha, now this certainly is funny... I don't suppose, $N, that you would mind doing one last favor for me?
287-complete.title: Frostmane Hold

291-accept.name: Senir Whitebeard
291-accept.text:
Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. He's in Ironforge, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.

Don't know the way to Ironforge? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east--there are large banners flanking the road--up the mountainside.

By the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?
291-accept.title: The Reports

310-complete.name: Unknown
310-complete.text: You quickly place Marleth's barrel of Barleybrew Scalder among the Thunderbrew barrels.
310-complete.title: Bitter Rivals

311-accept.name: Unknown
311-accept.text: Having inserted a barrel of Marleth's Scalder in the Kharanos Distillery's cellar, you grab a barrel of Thunder Ale as proof of the deed...
311-accept.title: Return to Marleth

311-complete.name: Marleth Barleybrew
311-complete.text:
Not bad, $N! Did you have a hard time getting past their guard?

No matter--many thanks, and if you're ever in need of stout with a kick, don't forget the Barleybrews!
311-complete.title: Return to Marleth

315-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-complete.text: Great!  I can't wait to use these in some of my recipes.  There's one in particular I think it'll work great in...
315-complete.title: The Perfect Stout

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

319-complete.name: Rejold Barleybrew
319-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  It'll be nice to work our crafts without hearing so many growls and snorts outside the village.
319-complete.title: A Favor for Evershine

320-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
320-accept.text: Here's your cask of Evershine, $N.  And again, thank you for the hunting earlier.
320-accept.title: Return to Bellowfiz

320-complete.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
320-complete.text: Yes, this will do just fine.  I think I'll open a bottle right now and have a taste...
320-complete.title: Return to Bellowfiz

412-complete.name: Razzle Sprysprocket
412-complete.text: These Gyromechanic Gears and Restabilization Cogs are in perfect accordance with Ozzie's schematics for the Recombobulation Device.  Once I add some hydrolubricant to the inner combustion pistons, adjust the crank-o-ratchet and increase of the viscosity of the electrogum gel, the gnomish race will be as good as new.
412-complete.title: Operation Recombobulation

412-progress.name: Razzle Sprysprocket
412-progress.text: The Recombobulator will be up and running as soon as we have sufficient Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.
412-progress.title: Operation Recombobulation

413-accept.name: Rejold Barleybrew
413-accept.text:
I'd like my brother Wellart to try my new Shimmer Stout.  He's a Mountaineer stationed in the southern guard tower, one of two towers on the border to Loch Modan.

He may not be a brewer like the rest of us Barleybrews, but he loves his drinks and I know he'll like this one.

Can you bring him this Barrel of Shimmer Stout for me?
413-accept.title: Shimmer Stout

6064-accept.name: Grif Wildheart
6064-accept.text:
Hi there, lad! So, you'd be wanting to know how you can gain a pet of your own?

Well, let's get started. There's nothing more important than yer equipment when it comes to hunting, but we can chat about my new Shrapnel Blaster some other time. Fer now, let's focus on something I'm sure you're quite interested in: a pet!

The best way to learn is for you to try out several creatures as companions and see what ya like. So, find a large crag boar, then use the taming rod to tame it.
6064-accept.title: Taming the Beast

6064-complete.name: Grif Wildheart
6064-complete.text: I know, I know; you're wondering what's next, aren't ya?!
6064-complete.title: Taming the Beast

6064-progress.name: Grif Wildheart
6064-progress.text: Don't worry, lad! You'll get ta try a few before you'll need to decide on just one.
6064-progress.title: Taming the Beast

96058-complete.name: Bronk Guzzlegear
96058-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
96058-complete.title: Camping 101: Engineering

96408-accept.name: Beldin Steelgrill
96408-accept.text:
Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
96408-accept.title: A Visitor to Dun Morogh

98326-complete.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-complete.text:
Yer a real lifesaver, $N!

My husband would just laugh it off, but I couldn't bear tellin' him he has to spend another night on the lake. Maybe now we can enjoy a real feast.
98326-complete.title: Frosthowl

98326-progress.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-progress.text: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
98326-progress.title: Frosthowl
